_readme: DGE chandas engine name (dge/js/chandas.js, normalised: no '(…)' suffix, no '— vipulā' suffix) → Vāgdhenu reference-bank key (src/reference_bank/bank.json). Metres without a bank clip fall back by pāda syllable count, then to vasantatilakā (Vāgdhenu's own fallback). Regenerate the bank side when Kamadhenu's own reference bank exists (kamadhenu_dataset/reference_bank.json).
